title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is used to model the probability of a binary outcome based on one or more predictor variables. In this case, we are using a single predictor variable, $x$.

title: Logistic Function
text: The logistic function is given by $P(Y=1|x)=1/(1+e**(-z))$, where $z$ is a linear combination of the predictors. In this case, $z=\beta_0+\beta_1*x$.

title: Interpreting the Probability
text: The probability $$\$P(Y=1|x=4)\$$$ is the likelihood that the response variable $Y$ equals $$1$$ given that the predictor variable $x$ is $$4$$.

title: Calculating the Probability
text: Assume that the logistic regression model has been fitted and the coefficients are such that $$\$P(Y=1|x=4)\$$$ is closest to one of the given options. Calculate the probability using the logistic function.
